# Toggle

Toggle is a fieldtype for storing yes/no or on/off data.

:::note
The following examples use a field named `toggle_field`. This should be replaced with your field name.
:::

<Tabs groupId="template-language">
<TabItem value="twig" label="Twig">

```twig
{{ entry.toggle_field }}

{% if entry.toggle_field == '1' %}
    Yes
{% else %}
    No
{% endif %}
```

</TabItem>
<TabItem value="blade" label="Blade">

```php
{{ $entry->toggle_field }}

@if($entry->toggle_field == '1')
    Yes
@else
    No
@endif
```

</TabItem>
</Tabs>

:::info
See the ExpressionEngine Documentation for more information on the [Toggle fieldtype](https://docs.expressionengine.com/latest/fieldtypes/toggle.html)
:::
